dedupe_keys.name: decarbonised index tracking portfolio optimisation with mean var and mean es and carbon footprint constraints 2025

description: This model builds decarbonised indices that track the US S&P 500 and the Indian NIFTY 50 by choosing portfolio weights that minimise mean-value-at-risk or mean-expected-shortfall while cutting exposure to companies with high carbon footprints, using two different methods whose performance is compared. The aim is to let investors balance financial performance and decarbonisation, and to encourage excluded or underweighted companies to lower their emissions; the authors suggest such indices may suit long-term passive investors better than green stocks. It was developed by Suparna Biswas and Rituparna Sen and posted on arXiv on 24 December 2025. Coverage is the US and Indian equity markets. The preprint is available free online; only the arXiv licence link is shown and no code is linked. Caveats: it is a preprint, carbon footprint data sources are not named in the abstract, and it treats transition risk only through emissions. For simulation it offers an optimisation step for how investors might reallocate capital away from carbon-intensive industries in transition risk scenarios. It is related to the transition risk in investment funds model record in this catalogue.
